text:
omar: hey team, first morning at Redwood! quick gear issues: laptop boots and docks but two things: 1) Corp-WiFi connects but i get no internet (page loads blank / curl times out) 2) wired keyboard and mouse plugged into the dock's USB ports aren't detected. opened TKT-21701.

jen-onboarding: welcome @omar!!! :tada: tagging IT and ops. sorry for the headache. did the dock come with the short usb-c cable or a thunderbolt one?

omar: it came with a short USB-C cable only (no TB badge). monitors + power ok, but USB hub shows nothing.

rachel-it: hey omar, welcome. for the Wi-Fi: can you paste output of `ipconfig /all` (Windows) or `ifconfig -a && route print`? also does the laptop show a Corp-WiFi IP like 10.x.x.x or a 169.254.x.x APIPA address?

omar: running `ipconfig` now. DHCP enabled for wireless adapter, IP: 169.254.12.34, Subnet Mask: 255.255.0.0, Gateway: none. 

rachel-it: got it — APIPA address, so DHCP didn't hand out a lease. try two quick things: 1) in an elevated cmd run `ipconfig /release && ipconfig /renew` and paste the result 2) try connecting the laptop to the dock via the other USB-C port (if available) to rule out dock cable fault.

omar: did release/renew, shows "Unable to contact your DHCP server." reconnected cable to the other port on laptop, no change.

rachel-it: thanks. can you try connecting the laptop to the wired network directly (use the USB-C -> ethernet adapter from the kit or plug into docking station ethernet)? if wired also shows APIPA, likely port provisioning issue or MAC blocking on switch.

omar: wired through dock ethernet also gives 169.254. same on the laptop's own ethernet dongle when i plug it direct.

rachel-it: ok that's good troubleshooting. looks like your device never completed network enrollment so switch is denying DHCP for unknown devices. i'll kick TKT-21701 to network ops to check MAC allowlist. meanwhile, for USB hub: can you open Device Manager > View > Show hidden devices, and look under "Universal Serial Bus controllers" for any yellow triangles or for the keyboard under "Keyboards"? also try uninstalling the composite USB entries and scanning for hardware changes.

omar: checked Device Manager: under USB controllers there's "Unknown USB Device (Port Reset Failed)" with a warning icon. keyboards not listed.

rachel-it: that often means the dock's firmware needs updating or it's a bad cable. tom-ops, any spare replacement cable or spare dock we can stage?

tom-ops: @rachel-it @omar we have a spare USB-C dock on shelf B2 and a USB-C cable in locker 6 (code 5532). I can leave the cable + an external keyboard in locker 6 if you want to pick up. If you'd rather, we can ship a replacement dock overnight.

omar: locker pickup sounds fastest, i'll grab the cable now. thanks tom.

rachel-it: i'll also request network team to check port/auth. tagging @netbot to run a DHCP snoop on the switch for omar's MAC.

netbot: [automated] DHCP lease request log queried for MAC 00:1A:4B:5C:6D:7E — no lease issued from DHCP pool; switch port policy: quarantine.

rachel-it: netbot confirmed quarantine. i've removed quarantine for your port and cleared lease reservations. try `ipconfig /renew` now.

omar: renewed, got IP 10.42.12.8, gateway 10.42.12.1, internet works now. thanks!

omar: also tried new cable from locker, USB hub enumerated and keyboard works. all good. closing TKT-21701 from my side. :white_check_mark: really appreciate the fast help everyone!

jen-onboarding: great news — welcome again and congrats on first working dev environment :party_parrot:
